name: Frame Window Counter
description: Automatically shows how many 240 FPS frames of leeway every click and release had.

enabled.name: Enable Overlay
enabled.description: Show the frame window overlay while playing. Inputs are still recorded when it is hidden.

hud-rows.name: Rows Shown
hud-rows.description: How many of your latest inputs the overlay lists.

show-offsets.name: Show Early / Late Leeway
show-offsets.description: Also show how many frames earlier and later each input could have been, e.g. (-1.25 / +0.75).

show-ineffective.name: List Inputs With No Effect
show-ineffective.description: Also list inputs that did not change your movement (for example releasing as the cube, or clicking in mid-air).

max-window.name: Max Window (frames)
max-window.description: Windows larger than this are shown as "free". Higher values run more test players.

resolution.name: Precision (frames)
resolution.description: Smallest timing step tested, in 240 FPS frames. 0.25 tells 0-1 (needs more than 240 FPS) apart from 1-2 reliably. Bigger windows are always tested in coarser steps.

check-ahead.name: Check Ahead (seconds)
check-ahead.description: How long a shifted input has to keep you alive (with all your later inputs unchanged) to count as working. Test players that end up exactly where you are stop early.

max-ghosts.name: Max Test Players
max-ghosts.description: Limit on hidden test players running at once. Lower this if the game lags; fewer timings get tested when the limit is hit.

show-test-players.name: Show Test Player Hitboxes
show-test-players.description: Draw the hitboxes of the hidden test players. Green = your timing, blue = earlier, orange = later, white = no input.

show-level-labels.name: Show Frame Windows In The Level
show-level-labels.description: Pop up each click's frame window above the spot where you clicked, like in replays.

level-labels-max.name: Level Frame Windows: Max Shown
level-labels-max.description: Only pop up frame windows in the level for clicks with at most this many frames (the hard ones).

replay-labels.name: Frame Windows In Replays
replay-labels.description: Pop up each click's frame window above the player in replays and saved clips.

mic-enabled.name: Record Microphone
mic-enabled.description: Record your microphone while you play, so replays and clips include your click sounds.

mic-device.name: Microphone Name
mic-device.description: Set by Choose Microphone. Empty = the first one found.

clip-game-volume.name: Clip: Game Sound Volume
clip-game-volume.description: Volume of the level's music in saved clips.

clip-mic-volume.name: Clip: Input Sound Volume
clip-mic-volume.description: Volume of your microphone (click sounds) in saved clips and replays.

clip-key-last.name: Save Last Attempt
clip-key-last.description: Saves your last attempt as an MP4 clip.

clip-key-last-two.name: Save Last Attempt + End Of The One Before
clip-key-last-two.description: Saves the end of the attempt before your last one, followed by your last attempt.

prev-tail.name: Seconds Of The Attempt Before
prev-tail.description: How much of the end of the previous attempt the second keybind includes.

clip-codec.name: Clip Codec
clip-codec.description: Leave empty to pick automatically (libx264, or your GPU's encoder).

clip-save-wav.name: Also Save Audio As WAV
clip-save-wav.description: Save the clip's audio as an uncompressed .wav next to the MP4 (for video editors).

report-on-death.name: Open Report On Death
report-on-death.description: Automatically open the full run report every time you die. Off by default because it gets in the way of quick respawns. You can always open it from the pause menu.
